{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Calculate total orders and converted orders per segment
total_by_segment = df.groupby('customer_segment').size()
converted_by_segment = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].sum()

# Compute conversion rate as percentage
total_by_segment = total_by_segment.astype(float)
converted_by_segment = converted_by_segment.astype(float)
conversion_rate_percent = (converted_by_segment / total_by_segment) * 100

# Explicitly print each value to ensure it is captured in evidence
print(f"loyal conversion rate: {conversion_rate_percent['loyal']}")
print(f"new conversion rate: {conversion_rate_percent['new']}")
print(f"returning conversion rate: {conversion_rate_percent['returning']}")

# Also print the full series to capture all values
print("\nFull conversion rates:")
print(conversion_rate_percent)"}
